value.rationale: A complete smooth-family coefficientwise 2-rank/a-number classification and uniform all-q model counts address a natural moduli arithmetic question. A separate exhaustive no-supersingular statement for all 48 rank-zero models over the first quadratic field supplies a genuinely finite but natural cutoff for searches for supersingular genus-four cyclic covers. Not merely the nonzero of a random coefficient or an isolated sample; the statement covers an entire normalized arithmetic family.
